title: AEDYN JAMES team up with A-Train for a new single "Sneaky Links"
htmlContent:
AEDYN JAMES shares a new single called "Sneaky Links," featuring A-Train. The single "Sneaky Links" is stand out record full of vibrant energy to get you through. It delivers in every way musically to make you admire the sounds, while also just being a record you can play and enjoy life more with the party being brought you in this ultimate jam.

AEDYN JAMES comes together with A-Train to brings an incredible infectious record that will make you dance for every second on the new song “Sneaky Links”. As soon as you hit play you feel like you’re at the rave of a lifetime, with a big time sound that keeps the music bumping a real way.
